notes: New: your Muse clones now update themselves. Whenever the real Muse app on your phone gets a Play Store update, DevxyzMuse silently re-installs the new Muse build into every clone the next time you open it (checked at most once per hour, no prompts, no dialogs). It is an in-place update inside each clone - data and sign-ins are preserved, exactly like a normal app update. If an update ever fails, the reason is written to the Diagnostic Log (clone-auto-update lines). Also includes the v1.0.2 Settings-crash fix. Installs in place - clones and sign-ins are preserved.
